description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

In-Depth Engineering Corporation develops and modernizes critical Department of the Navy capabilities, including combat systems and submarine warfare software. The company seeks mid-level Software Engineers to develop, integrate, test, and document combat system software using modern automation tools in an Agile environment, primarily with C++ and Java on Linux.
Software engineer developing, integrating, testing, and documenting Linux-based combat system software

Responsibilities:
• Utilize modern software automation tools in an Agile environment to develop combat system software
• Design, develop, integrate, and test software
• Principally object-oriented C++ and Java in a Linux environment
• Prepare software engineering design documentation
• Prepare and present engineering material within the peer review process, to leadership and to customer as appropriate

Requirements:
• US citizen
• have or be able to obtain a Department of Defense secret clearance
• BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering
• 1 year of professional experience
• Experience with C++ and/or Java

Skills:

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering

Pay: $75K/yr - $100K/yr
